title: Key-based pagination tokens in both languages
description:
Design §3.1 and §2.2 (`nextToken`). Replace the offset tokens.

## Steps
1. Specs first: `features/pagination/key_tokens.feature` (story "Pages continue after the last key"). Update the existing pagination specs that assume offsets.
2. A token is opaque: base64url of `{"v":1, "table", "index", "partition", "last": {"pk", "sort"}, "args": <sha256 of the query minus the token>}`. The next page starts strictly after `last`, using the ordered buckets from V4.
3. A token whose table, index, partition or args don't match the query gives `InvalidToken`.

## Acceptance
- `make check` green.
- The "insert before the cursor" scenario passes in both languages.

`make check PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python`
